source_text: Sumpsit Maria prophetissa tympanum; exierunt omnes mulieres post eam. Anima prophetans laudat; sensus carnales sequuntur in ordine. Cantemus et nos egressi mare. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Took Mary prophetess tambourine; went-out all women after her. Soul prophesying praises; senses fleshly follow in order. Let-us-sing also we having-exited sea. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Miriam the prophetess took the tambourine; all the women went out after her >> Bible:Exodus 15:20-21]]. The prophesying soul leads praise; ordered affections follow. We too, having left the sea, must sing. Amen.
